retrieval_method: WebFetch (PDF→text; the extracted text contained no page numbers or page markers, so pages are recorded as unknown). Rows transcribed by the fetch model and cross-checked across three versions and repeated passes.

access_limits: https://ncdhhs.servicenowservices.com/fee_schedules (NC DHHS 'Fee Schedule and Covered Code site', the official home of dental fee schedules since Nov. 3, 2022 per the NC Medicaid index page) — WebFetch error ROBOTS_DISALLOWED ('URL is disallowed by robots.txt rules'). The most recent schedule was therefore opened from the ADA-hosted copy, whose provenance rests on the ADA page's label 'Source: North Carolina Medicaid'.

The NC Medicaid index page states verbatim: 'Effective Nov. 3, 2022, NC Medicaid Dental Fee Schedules are located in the Fee Schedule and Covered Code site'. Only 2022-and-older schedules remain downloadable from medicaid.ncdhhs.gov.
PDF-to-text output for all three schedule versions carried no page numbers/page markers; 'page' is unknown for every row.
Total page count not determinable from the extracted text.
Descriptor of D7210 appears truncated at 'In Indicated' in the extracted text of the 2025 and 2026 copies; recorded as extracted.
One pass listing the full D7xxx/D5xxx/D99xx code inventories gave code numbers without descriptors; those inventories are noted but not used as evidence.
